scope: Subphase 0 only; proposed contract awaiting explicit acceptance

identity.private_mapping: Per-view ordered (U, integer User ID) or (I, IP string); dense rows may change after expiry; never align IDs across organizations
identity.branch_isolation: Do not pool replay variants as independent natural events or combine pilot and accepted versions

feature_dtype: float32[N,8], finite; same ordered features for User and IP; no fitted statistics
edges: int64[2,E] dense local indices; one aggregated User-IP relation plus reverse edge; retained timestamped events underpin adjacency; no edge timestamp tensor in model packet

time.scoring: Exact graph asof t after the complete atomic timestamp batch; advance idle state for expiry; monotonic naive source timestamps
time.availability: All features/edges use observations at or before t; labels require exact label_time=t; sparse label schedules must process expiry transitions, never carry positives indefinitely
time.missing: Absent recent counts are zero; orphan nodes excluded; absent supervision is -1/masked

supervision.dtype: int64[N] y and bool[N] eligible mask, separate from model packet
supervision.positive: 1 when synthetic targeting evidence exists in (t-10 minutes,t]; positive takes precedence
supervision.clean_negative_candidate: 0 when recent evidence exists with no positive or ambiguous evidence; candidate does not certify benignness
supervision.ambiguous: -1 when recent original-source attack/takeover flags are true or unknown and no positive evidence
supervision.context_only: -1 when no recent evidence; IP nodes always masked
supervision.mask: eligible = y != -1; masked states excluded from supervised loss and primary FPR
supervision.join: Accepted GraphView.supervision checks exact org/time, duplicate Users, label domain and active supervised Users

split_policy: Reuse manifest split/seed/anchor/end; detailed cutoff audit, evaluation unit and FPR target are Subphase 1; TRAIN fits, VAL selects, TEST final locked evaluation only
leakage_policy: Deny by default: only the eight enumerated observable features enter x; raw IDs, IP strings, tokens, labels, masks and all other metadata remain outside the model
checkpoint_policy: Use accepted checksummed JSON/GZIP runtime state; verify org, time and branch provenance before reuse; representative TRAIN seed1001 endpoints are examples, never initial states for earlier scoring
versioning: Dataset ID = freeze version plus SHA256 of freeze manifest; inventory ID = SHA256 of sorted manifest-path/hash map; reports refuse overwrite
architecture: Five isolated local persistent bipartite graphs; User targets and IP context; no training in Subphase 0; no federation, DP, Fabric or cross-organization identity index
